message.text: This confirms it's neither of those options, but rather an in-process buffered Go channel, consistent with what I found earlier.

args.command: cd /bench/repo && grep -rni "nats\|rabbitmq\|amqp\|kafka\|pubsub\|sqs" --include=*.go . | grep -v "^./web/" | head; echo "=== go.mod ==="; grep -in "nats\|amqp\|rabbit\|kafka" go.mod go.sum | head
